You’ll build and ship the AI agents, automations and integrations that take admin work off our reps and managers and help our revenue teams sell, forecast and renew with more insight. You’ll sit in GTM Systems & Applied AI, work inside our AI Center of Excellence for GTM, and partner closely with Salesforce IT and the business teams who use what you build.
Why join Sprout’s Revenue Operations, Sales & Customer Experience team?
At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
What you’ll do
Design, build and ship AI agents, automations and integrations for Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Deal Desk and Revenue Operations, taking them from prototype to production.
Turn priority use cases from the GTM AI roadmap into working solutions with clear adoption and impact measures, starting with the ones that cut rep admin time.
Integrate AI solutions with Salesforce, Gong and other GTM systems, working with Salesforce IT on architecture, security and the release process.
Build evaluation, monitoring and guardrails so AI outputs are accurate, auditable and safe to use in revenue workflows.
Partner with the Business Analyst on requirements, test scenarios and UAT, and with Sales Enablement on rollout and adoption.
Contribute to AI Center of Excellence governance: technical standards, documentation, data access, and build-versus-buy reviews of tools and vendors.
Identify data quality and process gaps that limit AI performance, and help close them with RevOps and Salesforce IT.
Stay current on a fast-moving field, use AI coding tools in your own work, and share what works with the team.
What you’ll bring
You’re an engineer who ships. You’re comfortable owning a problem from idea through production, you care about whether AI outputs are actually right, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.
The minimum qualifications for this role include:
3+ years of experience in software engineering, data or machine learning engineering, or applied AI, including shipping production software.
Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompting, tool or function calling, retrieval, agents and evaluation.
Strong programming skills (Python or similar) and experience building APIs and system integrations.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to scope problems and deliver solutions independently.
Sound judgment on data security, privacy and access control when AI touches customer and revenue data.
Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred qualifications for this role include:
Experience integrating with Salesforce (APIs, Apex or flows) or a strong understanding of CRM data models.
Experience working with Gong or other conversation intelligence data.
Experience in a sales, revenue operations or go-to-market environment.
Experience with agent or workflow automation frameworks and AI evaluation tooling.
Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions for AI tools.
How you’ll grow
Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:
Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to building and governing AI for go-to-market teams.
Learn our GTM stack, the Salesforce and Gong data available to build on, and how Salesforce IT handles security and releases.
Ship a small prototype or quick win with a pilot group.
Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:
Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building.
Ship your first AI solution to a pilot group with defined success measures.
Set up the evaluation and monitoring approach for your solutions with the Director of GTM Systems & Applied AI.
Agree on integration and security patterns with Salesforce IT.
Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:
Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth.
Move at least one solution into production at scale, with adoption and impact measured.
Contribute to the AI Center of Excellence standards and documentation.
Work with the Business Analyst to make requirements and UAT part of every AI release.
Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:
Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
Own a portfolio of AI use cases from roadmap through adoption, with a clear record of time saved or revenue impact.
Shape build-versus-buy decisions for GTM AI tools.
Raise the technical bar for the team through standards, reusable components and shared practices.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. As a Backend Engineer, you will lead the backend development process for core components and build services from inception to deployment. This individual will be helping solve correctness, scaling, and reliability challenges on a backend-first, high-performance, and world-class institutional trading platform.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do

- Design and ship production services: Implement and operate resilient backend services and subsystems that move institutional money — contributing to flows such as cross-venue settlement, collateral credit, matched-book lending, and order execution.

- Author focused technical specs: Draft clear technical designs for new features and components, explicitly defining data invariants, error handling, state boundaries, and recovery mechanisms before writing code.

- Build for failure: Write clean, idiomatic, and thoroughly tested code, pairing production features with rigorous unit/integration tests, sensible monitoring, structured logging, and targeted alerts.

- Maintain operational health: Actively participate in the team's on-call rotation, debug production anomalies, and contribute to blameless post-mortems and remediation work to harden our platform.

- Collaborate and review: Participate in architectural discussions and provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews to help maintain high code quality and consistency across the team.

What you bring

- Proven backend track record: Solid experience independently designing, implementing, and maintaining backend services in a production environment, taking full ownership of what you ship.

- Correctness-critical mindset: Hands-on experience with financial, transactional, or distributed systems (e.g., payments, ledgers, trading, order management, or inventory engines) where data integrity is paramount and mistakes are costly.

- Systems fundamentals: Strong understanding of distributed systems and transactional boundaries, including relational data modeling (PostgreSQL), data consistency, idempotency, and asynchronous workflows/message queues.

- Defensive engineering: Good design judgment and an instinct to test failure paths; you think about race conditions, boundary failures, and network partitions rather than just the happy path.

- Language fluency: Proficiency in a modern backend language (such as Python or Go), with the ability to quickly get up to speed on our core stack (Python/Django and Go).

- Clear communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can clearly explain technical trade-offs, document system behaviors, and collaborate effectively with peers and cross-functional partners.

What we offer

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and shape the future of global institutional finance

- Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

- Top-tier health benefits to fuel your work, including 100% employer-paid private medical insurance for you and comprehensive coverage for dependents, alongside mental health and wellbeing support programs

- Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future

- Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more

- Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees

- Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, company holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off

Team/ Role Paragraph:
Blockchain Insights is Coinbase's internal onchain intelligence platform. It combines address attribution from internal teams and external vendors with multi-chain transaction data, and powers KYT, risk scoring, and sanctions screening. Compliance, investigations, and risk teams rely on Blockchain Insights to trace funds and keep Coinbase safe and compliant, and a growing share of that use comes through AI agents via our MCP server. As an engineer on the team, you'll build the data pipelines, services, and agent-facing tools that make this intelligence accurate, fresh, and easy to act on.
What you’ll do:
Build and scale Golang services and Databricks/Kafka pipelines that ingest, normalize, and serve address metadata and transaction history across a growing set of blockchains.
Improve data freshness, accuracy, and provenance so investigators and risk systems can trust data and see where it came from.
Extend Blockchain Insights' AI surface, including our MCP server and agent workflows, so analysts and engineers can query onchain intelligence directly from tools like Claude and Cursor.
Use AI agents across the development lifecycle (design, implementation, testing, review, and incident triage) and automate repetitive operational work such as data onboarding and oncall triage.
Partner with compliance, investigations, and product teams to turn their needs into a quarterly roadmap, and help set the technical direction for the platform.
Write high-quality, well-tested code and help keep a platform that critical compliance workflows depend on reliable.
Required Skills and Experience:
3+ years of software engineering experience, including designing, building, scaling, and maintaining production backend services.
Solid grasp of service-oriented architecture and of data-intensive systems such as streaming pipelines, large-scale storage, and query performance.
High standards for code quality and testing, applied equally to code you write by hand and code generated with AI.
Daily use of AI coding tools, with good judgment about where they speed you up and where they need close review.
Ability to break ambiguous problems into well-scoped tasks with clear context and acceptance criteria, for yourself, your teammates, or an agent.
Passion for building an open financial system that brings the world together.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
